subject: SOURCE FORMAT directive
notes: >> SOURCE FORMAT IS { FIXED | FREE }, verified against the PRINTED page (folio 84): SOURCE, FIXED and FREE are underlined required words, FORMAT and IS are 5.2.3 optional words, and the braces are a plain required choice. The optional words are the row's optionalWords, so >>SOURCE FREE and >>SOURCE FORMAT IS FREE both select FREE; an operand that is neither, or none at all, is COBOL1911 and the line is still consumed (the reference format in effect carries on, since the directive selected none). kb/Work PB794. retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Frontend/Preprocessor/ReferenceFormatProcessor.cs#TryMatchDirective (kb/Work PB1361 (w70b) replaced the format-blind TryMatchDirective pre-scan with the in-order FormatSegments walk, which recognizes the directive by its word through CompilerDirectiveLine in the program-text area of the format in effect)
